data.one_liner: Cupertino buttons used as radio buttons for selecting a single value.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Cupertino-styled radio choice widget that allows users to select a single value from a map of choices. It takes a set of choices, an initial key value, and an onChange callback to handle selections.
use_when: You are building a Cupertino-styled app and need single-selection radio buttons.
You want a simple widget to map key-value pairs into selectable options.
avoid_when: You need Material Design radio buttons.
You need complex form validation or custom field builders.
strengths: Simple API with required parameters for choices and change callbacks.
weaknesses: Very narrow scope, limited to a single widget function.
